events.title: Generac Tops Q1 Earnings Estimates, Lifts 2026 Revenue Outlook
events.body: GNRC beats EPS and sales estimates in Q1, fueled by strong data center demand, and raises its 2026 revenue growth outlook to the mid-to-high teens.

events.title: DOV Q1 Deep Dive: Robust Order Growth and Infrastructure Demand Support Outlook
events.body: Manufacturing company Dover (NYSE:DOV) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 10.1% year on year to $2.05 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.28 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
